problem: Why the load stopped — and the one step that clears it
action: Under the canopy. Chest-up on the dealer looking down at his phone held in both hands, reading with a small satisfied nod, already turning to go and do something about it. There is purpose in him — this is a man with an answer and a next step.
lighting: Clean bright daylight, soft shadow under the canopy, the forecourt bright and out of focus behind him.
camera: Chest-up, he fills the vertical frame, head upper third. Sharp. 35mm. Deliberately the mirror of the earlier shot of him on the unanswered phone.
detail: The phone screen is DARK and unreadable. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: The relief of knowing what is actually wrong, after a day of not knowing.
motion: He nods once and begins to turn his shoulders as if to walk off, but does not leave frame. A slow push in. No cuts, no camera shake, nobody speaks.

voice_over.hi: लोड क्यों रुका है — और उसे खोलने का एक क़दम।
